newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania maize harvest 94 percent complete.
newsitem.headline: Romania maize harvest 94 percent complete.

text.p: Romania has harvested 94 percent of its 1996 maize crop, and estimates put final output at around 9.5 million tonnes, close to 1995's bumper crop of 9.678 million, the farm ministry said.
Output from the 3.12 million hectares harvested so far was 9.07 million tonnes at an average of 2,905 kg per ha, slightly up on initial estimates of 2,712, it said in a statement.
The remaining 166,000 ha under maize were expected to yield another 500,000 tonnes, it said.
"The 1996 crop will be enough to cover both the population's demand and provide fodder...We will also have some exports."
Last year Romania exported some 1.0 million tonnes of maize.
